'# === PARANDATUD R SKRIPT: FILTREERITAV VISUAAL TOP 5 LOOGIKAGA ===

# 1. Vajalike pakettide laadimine
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(scales))
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 2. Kontrollime Power BI sliceri seisundit (Kaldkriipsud eemaldatud!)
valitud_maakonnad <- unique(dataset$county_name)
kokku_maakondi_andmetes <- length(valitud_maakonnad)

# 3. Andmebaasi ühenduse loomine
con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),
                 dbname = "postgres",
                 host = "localhost",
                 port = 5432,
                 user = "postgres",
                 password = "andmed")

# 4. Andmete pärimine PostgreSQL-ist
query <- "
SELECT 
    c.county_name,
    t.year_number,
    AVG(k.avg_price_m2)::NUMERIC(10,2) AS avg_price_m2,
    AVG(p.average_salary)::NUMERIC(10,2) AS avg_salary,
    SUM(k.transaction_count) AS total_transactions
FROM grupitoo_kv.fact_kv k
INNER JOIN grupitoo_kv.fact_palk p ON k.fk_quarter_id = p.fk_quarter_id AND k.fk_county_id = p.fk_county_id
INNER JOIN grupitoo_kv.dim_time t ON k.fk_quarter_id = t.pk_quarter_id
INNER JOIN grupitoo_kv.dim_county c ON k.fk_county_id = c.pk_county_id
GROUP BY c.county_name, t.year_number
ORDER BY c.county_name, t.year_number;
"

df_data <- dbGetQuery(con, query)
dbDisconnect(con)

# 5. DÜNAAMILINE FILTREERIMINE (TOP 5 vs Sliceri valik)
koik_maakonnad_baasis <- unique(df_data$county_name)

if (kokku_maakondi_andmetes >= length(koik_maakonnad_baasis)) {
  # Kui slicer on tühi, leiame 5 kõige aktiivsemat maakonda
  top_5_maakonnad <- df_data %>%
    group_by(county_name) %>%
    summarise(kogu_maht = sum(total_transactions, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    top_n(5, kogu_maht) %>%
    pull(county_name)
  
  df_filtered <- df_data %>% filter(county_name %in% top_5_maakonnad)
  graafiku_subtitle <- "Kuvatakse 5 kõige suurema tehinguaktiivsusega maakonda (filtreerimata)"
} else {
  # Kui kasutaja tegi valiku, näitame ainult valitud maakondi
  df_filtered <- df_data %>% filter(county_name %in% valitud_maakonnad)
  graafiku_subtitle <- "Valitud maakondade trajektoor (2005-2025)"
}

# 6. Staatilise Visuaali Joonistamine Power BI ekraanile
visuaal_staatiline <- ggplot(df_filtered, aes(x = avg_salary, y = avg_price_m2, color = county_name)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = total_transactions), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = unit_format(unit = " €", sep = "")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = unit_format(unit = " €/m²", sep = "")) +
  scale_size_continuous(labels = comma, range = c(3, 12)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Kinnisvarahindade ja Keskmise Palga Seos Eestis",
    subtitle = graafiku_subtitle,
    x = "Keskmine Brutokuupalk (€)",
    y = "Korterite Keskmine Ruutmeetri Hind (€/m²)",
    color = "Maakond",
    size = "Tehinguaktiivsus"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#1a1a1a"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "#555555"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_filtered %>% group_by(county_name) %>% filter(year_number == max(year_number)),
    aes(label = county_name),
    fontface = "bold", size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE, box.padding = 0.5
  )

print(visuaal_staatiline)'
